experience_source.quote: Present to the board a valid diploma from a medical college in good standing with the board or have been actively engaged in the practice of medicine, in a manner determined by the board to have been satisfactory, for not less than four years under a temporary permit issued pursuant to R.S. 37:1275

exams.name: Medical licensing examination (state-designed or national agency)
exams.notes: Board may design its own exam or use examinations from any national examining agency, public or private.
exams.quote: Pass an examination which the board deems sufficient to test the applicant's fitness to practice medicine in this state. The board may design or administer its own examination, or it may use examinations from any national examining agency, either public or private

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA)
exams.notes: Required for eligibility under the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact expedited licensure pathway; each component must be passed within three attempts.
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA) within three attempts

interval_years.quote: Every license issued under this Part shall be renewed annually upon payment of the required renewal fee.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The renewal of any license, certificate, registration, or permit issued by the board shall not exceed three hundred dollars.

required.quote: The board shall have the authority to establish and determine by rule minimum requirements relative to continuing education for the renewal or reinstatement of any license or permit issued by the board.

approximate.matched_normalized: have the authority to establish and determine by rule minimum requirements relative to continuing education for the renewal or reinstatement of any license or permit issued by the board

value: 1-hour course on treatment of sickle cell disease for physicians practicing emergency medicine (initial); 1-hour refresher no less frequently than every 3 years

Minimum 1 hour on nutrition and metabolic health every 4 years for physicians practicing family medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, psychiatry, endocrinology, gastroenterology, cardiology, oncology, rheumatology, neurology, nephrology, dermatology, pulmonology, surgery, immunology, hematology, obstetrics, and gynecology
topical_requirements.quote: The board shall require physicians and physician assistants practicing emergency medicine to complete an initial one-hour continuing education course on the treatment of sickle cell disease.

available.quote: The board may issue a license as provided for in R.S. 37:1274, without examination in this state, to any applicant possessing a valid, unrestricted license to practice medicine, whether allopathic or osteopathic, or osteopathy in any other state of the United States provided the board is satisfied that the license from the other state is based upon an examination and other requirements substantially equivalent to the requirements of this Part.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid, unrestricted license in another U.S. state based on examination and requirements substantially equivalent to Louisiana's requirements. The board may also issue expedited licenses through the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a license as provided for in R.S. 37:1274, without examination in this state, to any applicant possessing a valid, unrestricted license to practice medicine, whether allopathic or osteopathic, or osteopathy in any other state of the United States provided the board is satisfied that the license from the other state is based upon an examination and other requirements substantially equivalent to the requirements of this Part.

exists.quote: The Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners Physician Assistants Advisory Committee is hereby created within the Louisiana Department of Health.

name.value: Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners Physician Assistants Advisory Committee
name.quote: The Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners Physician Assistants Advisory Committee is hereby created within the Louisiana Department of Health.

authority.value: Advises the Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners on all matters specifically dealing with licensing or disciplining of physician assistants or drafting and promulgating of regulations related to physician assistants; reviews and makes recommendations to the board on applications for licensure as physician assistants; the board shall not act on any matter relating to a physician assistant without first consulting with the advisory committee.
authority.quote: The duties and purpose of the advisory committee shall be to advise the Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners on all matters specifically dealing with licensing or disciplining of physician assistants or the drafting and promulgating of regulations related to physician assistants. The advisory committee shall also review and make recommendations to the board on applications for licensure as physician assistants. The board shall not act on any matter relating to a physician assistant without first consulting with the advisory committee.

national_association.value: American Board of Medical Specialties; American Osteopathic Association
national_association.quote: Holds specialty certification or a time-unlimited specialty certificate recognized by the American Board of Medical Specialties or the American Osteopathic Association's Bureau of Osteopathic Specialists

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part, a permit or registration as provided for in this Part, or a certificate issued pursuant to Part I-D of this Chapter.

credential_type.quote: If the requirements of R.S. 37:1272 or R.S. 37:1276 are met to the satisfaction of the board, the board shall issue to the applicant a license to practice medicine.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part

title_protection.quote: Unlicensed physicians shall not be permitted to collect any fees or charges for services rendered, or be allowed to testify as a medical expert in any court, or execute public or legal documents as a physician, or hold any medical office, or be recognized by the state or parish or municipal corporation as a physician

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony under Louisiana or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a crime or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a criminal charge constituting a felony under the laws of Louisiana or of the United States.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime arising out of or in connection with the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a crime or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any criminal charge arising out of or in connection with the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or perjury in obtaining any diploma, license, or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, or perjury in obtaining any diploma, license, or permit pertaining to this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false testimony or false sworn information to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing false testimony before the board or providing false sworn information to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or recurring abuse of drugs, including alcohol
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or recurring abuse of drugs, including alcohol, which affect the central nervous system and which are capable of inducing physiological or psychological dependence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering controlled substances without legitimate medical justification or in an illegal manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering legally controlled substances or any dependency-inducing medication without legitimate medical justification therefor or in other than a legal or legitimate manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation of patients or self-promotion through fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation of patients or self-promotion through advertising or communication, public or private, which is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or submitting false, deceptive, or unfounded claims to obtain economic value
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or submitting false, deceptive, or unfounded claims, reports, or opinions to any patient, insurance company or indemnity association, company, individual, or governmental authority for the purpose of obtaining anything of economic value.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill or safety due to mental illness, physical illness, or substance abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill or safety due to mental illness or deficiency, including but not limited to deterioration through the aging process or the loss of motor skills or excessive use or abuse of drugs, including alcohol.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including sexual misconduct, disruptive behavior, failing to cooperate with the board, improperly delegating, enabling unauthorized practice, etc.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct, including but not limited to, conduct manifested as sexual misconduct, disruptive behavior, failing to cooperate with the board, failing to maintain independent medical judgment, improperly delegating or supervising, exercising undue influence, enabling the unauthorized practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Medical incompetency manifested by recurring practice failing to satisfy prevailing standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Medical incompetency, including but not limited to, incompetency manifested by continuing or recurring medical practice which fails to satisfy the prevailing and usually accepted standards of medical practice in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in exercising license privileges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in exercising the privileges provided for by license or permit issued under this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross, willful, and continued overcharging for professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross, willful, and continued overcharging for professional services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting an unlicensed person to practice medicine or having professional connection with an illegal practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly performing any act which, in any way, assists an unlicensed person to practice medicine, or having professional connection with or lending one's name to an illegal practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting or accepting anything of economic value for patient referrals or prescription of medications
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting, accepting, or receiving anything of economic value in return for and based on the referral of patients to another person, firm, or corporation or in return for the prescription of medications or medical devices.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistent violation of federal or state laws relative to control of social diseases
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Persistent violation of federal or state laws relative to control of social diseases.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interdiction or commitment by due process of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interdiction or commitment by due process of law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal, revocation, suspension, or surrender of a license in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state to issue or renew a license, permit, or certificate to practice medicine in that state or the revocation, suspension, or other restriction imposed on a license, permit, or certificate issued by such licensing authority which prevents or restricts practice in that state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rules and regulations of the board, or any provisions of this Part
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rules and regulations of the board, or any provisions of this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to self-report in writing to the board any personal action constituting a violation within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a physician to self-report in writing to the board any personal action which constitutes a violation of this Part within thirty days of the occurrence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out as board-certified unless specific criteria are met
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Holding oneself out to the public in any manner as being certified by a public or private board including but not limited to a multidisciplinary board or 'board certified', unless all of the following criteria are satisfied

definition_quote.value: The practice of medicine, whether allopathic or osteopathic, means the holding out of one's self to the public as being engaged in the business of, or the actual engagement in, the diagnosing, treating, curing, or relieving of any bodily or mental disease, condition, infirmity, deformity, defect, ailment, or injury in any human being, other than himself, whether by the use of any drug, instrument or force, whether physical or psychic, or of what other nature, or any other agency or means; or the examining, either gratuitously or for compensation, of any person or material from any person for such purpose whether such drug, instrument, force, or other agency or means is applied to or used by the patient or by another person; or the attending of a woman in childbirth without the aid of a licensed physician or midwife.
definition_quote.quote: "The practice of medicine", whether allopathic or osteopathic, means the holding out of one's self to the public as being engaged in the business of, or the actual engagement in, the diagnosing, treating, curing, or relieving of any bodily or mental disease, condition, infirmity, deformity, defect, ailment, or injury in any human being, other than himself, whether by the use of any drug, instrument or force, whether physical or psychic, or of what other nature, or any other agency or means

value: relieving bodily or mental disease, condition, infirmity, deformity, defect, ailment, or injury
examining persons or material for diagnostic/treatment purposes
methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosing, treating, curing, or relieving of any bodily or mental disease, condition, infirmity, deformity, defect, ailment, or injury in any human being, other than himself, whether by the use of any drug, instrument or force, whether physical or psychic

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, dispense, and administer drugs as part of the practice of medicine. Controlled dangerous substances may be prescribed via telemedicine only after an appropriate in-person patient history or physical examination, except in licensed healthcare facilities with a DEA registration.
drug_authority.quote: no physician practicing telemedicine pursuant to this Subsection shall prescribe any controlled dangerous substance prior to conducting an appropriate in-person patient history or physical examination of the patient as determined by the board

value: post graduate training registration or permit
license_status_types.quote: any initial restricted, provisional, or temporary license, certificate, registration, or permit issued by the board to a physician, including but not limited to an institutional license or permit, graduate education temporary permit, military physician permit, military intern permit, mini-residency preceptorship permit, post graduate training registration or permit, dispensing registration, reduced fee license, or visiting physician permit

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International medical graduates must hold a medical doctorate or substantially similar degree from an international program in good standing, be in good standing with the medical licensing institution of their licensing country, have completed a residency or substantially similar post-graduate training or practiced as a physician in their licensing country for no less than five years, be a U.S. or Canadian citizen or legally entitled to live/work in the U.S. with basic English fluency, and have an offer of employment at a facility owned or operated by a Louisiana-licensed hospital. They may provide medical services only at such a hospital facility for the first two years after licensure.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: The board may grant a license to practice medicine in this state to an international medical graduate who satisfies all of the following criteria

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician practicing telemedicine shall not prescribe any controlled dangerous substance prior to conducting an appropriate in-person patient history or physical examination, except when the patient is being treated at a licensed healthcare facility that holds a current DEA registration, in which case the physician may prescribe any controlled dangerous substance without an in-person examination.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Except as authorized by R.S. 37:1271.1 or otherwise by rule promulgated by the board, no physician practicing telemedicine pursuant to this Subsection shall prescribe any controlled dangerous substance prior to conducting an appropriate in-person patient history or physical examination of the patient as determined by the board.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: The board shall issue a telemedicine license to allow the practice of medicine across state lines to an applicant who holds a full and unrestricted license to practice medicine in another state or territory of the United States.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby recognized and enacted into law and entered into by this state with all states legally joining therein

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: Utilizing a physician's assistant without approval and recordation as required by law or permitting a physician's assistant, within his employment, to conduct activities outside of the designated scope of the assistant's approval and registration.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: the board shall charge and collect an additional annual fee of twenty-five dollars from each physician to be utilized for the identification, monitoring, assistance, and procurement of treatment of physicians suffering from substance abuse, chemical dependency, psychiatric conditions, or physical deficiencies which may interfere with their ability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Appoint or designate an examining committee of physicians, possessing appropriate qualifications, to conduct physical and mental examinations on a physician, to otherwise inquire into the physician's fitness and ability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients
